release_notes: Added: Cohort analysis — a new Analytics tab groups campaigns by the month or quarter they were created and tracks how each cohort performs as it ages (M0, M1, M2…). Retention curves, a heatmap matrix (with an Absolute / % of M0 toggle), and a per-cohort summary show whether recent launches are still taking off or total revenue is being carried by old campaigns — the exact 'delayed revenue' picture classic cohort analysis exists to surface. Revenue and conversions are attributed to the period the event occurred, not the click period, so delayed payouts no longer collapse into the launch month. Added: first-time visitors now land on the language their browser reports instead of a hard-coded Russian default; the same fix removes the hardcoded 'ru' fallback across user creation, login, and profile settings. Fixed: click.php returned a bare HTTP 500 on any campaign without a configured stream/offer (FOREIGN KEY constraint failed on offer_id = 0); clicks now log with offer_id NULL. Fixed: the Trends chart only plotted days that had traffic, so a single active day looked 'stuck' at the X origin — days and hours are now zero-filled across the selected range like the dashboard. Fixed: hardcoded Russian labels in the Trends chart tooltip and in Cohort date/number formatting now follow the selected UI language across all seven locales.
